To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the PdNi hydrogen gas sensor with the integrated temperature sensor can be used to measure the output response of hydrogen sensors at different temperatures and the temperature coefficient of the hydrogen sensor can be reduced by using the temperature sensor.

the PdNi and Pt thin film integrated sensors were fabricated using the MEMS process and the temperature measurement of Pt film can be used to reduce the impact of the hydrogen temperature on the performances (output response, response time, and recovery time) of the Pd thin film hydrogen sensor.
a PdNi film thin film hydrogen sensor integrated with Pt film temperature sensor has been fabricated using a microelectromechanical system process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of the MEMS-based integrated PdNi thin-film hydrogen sensor with integrated Pt temperature sensor.

the design and fabrication of a MEMS-based PdNi thin-film hydrogen sensor with integrated Pt temperature sensor and the study of the performances of the hydrogen sensors at different hydrogen concentrations and temperatures.
the design, fabrication and characterization of an integrated temperature and hydrogen sensors based on Pd and Pt thin films.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a MEMS-based PdNi thin-film hydrogen sensor with integrated Pt temperature sensor is developed, the TCR of PdNi film is measured and the impact of the operating temperature on the performance of the hydrogen sensor is reduced.
this work successfully developed a MEMS-based PdNi thin films hydrogen sensor with a built-in temperature sensor.
the integrated temperature and hydrogen sensor is an efficient way to reduce the impact of the operating temperature on the hydrogen sensor and improve the repeatability of hydrogen sensors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed, fabricated and investigated the performance of the integrated PdNi thin-film hydrogen sensor with the Pt thin film temperature sensors.
we successfully integrated Pt and PdNi film sensors using the MEMS process.
the integrated PdNi and Pt film sensors with the MEMS process can be used for the detection of the hydrogen gas in a wide temperature range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PdNi hydrogen sensor with the integrated Pt temperature sensor is a promising device for the hydrogen detection.
the PdNi alloy thin film hydrogen sensor with integrated temperature sensor can be used in harsh environments where the temperature fluctuation is large.
the PdNi hydrogen sensor integrated with Pt temperature sensor can be used in the hydrogen sensing system for the automotive application.
